The employment outlook will be Good for massage therapists (NOC 32201) in Nova Scotia for the 2025-2027 period.

The aging population has been a key factor supporting growth in demand for services, as well as expanding private medical insurance coverage and growing usage of massage therapy in the treatment of pain in primary care. The profession is physically demanding and can result in early-career attrition. Some clinics have reported difficulty in filling vacancies, especially in smaller communities throughout Nova Scotia.
